description: Resize a block storage volume (increase capacity only). Dedicated volume-size endpoint for Gen2 (XEN) storage. KVM-based block storage is NOT supported here — use ncloud_change_block_storage for KVM. If the volume is attached, the server must be stopped before resizing.

blockStorageInstanceNo.description: Block storage instance number to resize

blockStorageSize.description: New block storage size in GB (XEN: 10~2000, in 10GB increments, must be greater than current size)

name: ncloud_change_block_storage_size
